content.summary: Review of Claude Agent SDK Provider: NEEDS WORK due to missing tests

findings.issue: Code style is excellent. No 'let' or 'else' statements found. Generator usage in translate-prompt is well-implemented.
findings.suggestion: Maintain this style in future updates.

code.summary: Code quality is high and adheres to project standards.

findings.issue: Tools are correctly disabled (allowedTools: []) to prevent SDK execution.
findings.suggestion: Ensure this configuration cannot be overridden by provider options.

simplicity.summary: Implementation is straightforward and follows separation of concerns.

findings.issue: Missing unit tests for core logic. Only provider registration is tested. Logic in translate-prompt.ts and translate-stream.ts has 0% coverage.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for prompt translation and stream transformation to verify correctness of mapping.

findings.issue: Tool execution restriction and session management are implemented but not verified by tests.
findings.suggestion: Add integration test mocking the SDK to verify parameters passed.

requirements.summary: Critical functionality is implemented but untested.

blocking_issues: Missing unit tests for translate-prompt.ts and translate-stream.ts
No verification that tool calls are actually disabled in execution
suggestions: Verify session ID persistence logic with a test case
